title: Escape Candidate Workflow
goal: Implement the third BANDIT-PRD-004 slice: repo-native Escape Candidate and Boundary Escape Disposition evidence plus Codex PM attribution-review validation, without changing Boundary Contour movement policy.
scope: Use BANDIT-PRD-004 and docs/prds/BANDIT-PRD-004-005-decomposition.md as source authority for PRD-004.3 after BANDIT-089 and BANDIT-090 landed and closed PRD-004.1 and PRD-004.2.

Add repo-native Escape Candidate evidence for suspected boundary-autonomy failures, including work item, source head, review subject hash, Boundary Prediction Record link when present, Attribution Join Key link or hash when present, observed outcome, expected boundary outcome, escape signal, touched surface, evidence artifacts, reporter, and candidate status.

Add repo-native Boundary Escape Disposition evidence for Codex PM attribution review, including candidate link, attribution status, disposition verdict, rationale, required operator input status, evidence reviewed, and whether the result is confirmed_escape, no_escape, needs_repair, or operator_input_required.

Add deterministic validation helpers that fail closed for malformed Escape Candidate and Boundary Escape Disposition evidence, including blank work item, malformed source head or review subject hash, missing evidence artifacts, unsupported statuses, missing candidate links, invalid Attribution Join Key or Boundary Prediction Record references, and missing Codex PM attribution-review rationale.
Add aggregate validation wiring so npm run bandit -- validate reports malformed escape-candidate or escape-disposition artifacts in work-item evidence packages.
Add template/init support for Escape Candidate and Boundary Escape Disposition evidence while keeping the templates non-authoritative source guidance.

Add Codex PM attribution-review rules that refuse to guess when classification depends on product direction, UAT, business tradeoffs, policy changes, explicit cost/risk posture, or genuinely ambiguous scope.

Preserve CLI authority, repo-native canonical state, and derived-only cockpit/session-context status. No boundary-cell movement, contour contraction, autonomy expansion, Notify-And-Revert execution, rollback execution, model gateway, telemetry, local API, State Index, cockpit UI, hosted service, paid route, merge, push, deploy, or PRD-005 controller work is in scope.

Record CLEAN_CODE.md read evidence in the brief and require the implementation to keep escape artifact parsing, disposition validation, template checks, aggregate validation, and tests small, explicit, and separated from boundary movement policy.
out_of_scope: Do not implement Boundary Contour movement, Workflow Trial movement evidence, fail-closed contour contraction, autonomy expansion, Notify-And-Revert execution, rollback execution, operator attention delivery, or automatic policy changes.
Do not introduce a model-call gateway, local proxy, wrapper, telemetry backend, hosted service, provider integration, live model-call capture, or paid/live reviewer route.
Do not require Escape Candidate evidence for ordinary safe-to-land bootstrap flows that do not claim a boundary escape, boundary-autonomy failure, or escape disposition.

Do not approve a new boundary cell, change UAT policy, change reviewer routing, change risk-classification policy, change supply-chain policy, replace Trust Verifier behavior, or start BANDIT-PRD-005 implementation.

Do not start PRD-004.4, PRD-005, the V0 Closeout Claude Code A/B Product-Value Trial, cockpit UI, local API, State Index, hosted services, telemetry, public benchmark publication, paid routing, merge, push, deploy, credential handling, dependency changes, lockfile changes, package-script changes, CI/release workflow changes, external repo mutation, or unrelated Phase 8 work.
acceptance_criteria: The slice adds Escape Candidate evidence as a repo-native structured artifact for suspected boundary-autonomy failures without treating candidates as confirmed escapes.

The slice adds Boundary Escape Disposition evidence as a repo-native structured artifact for Codex PM attribution review, with verdicts for confirmed_escape, no_escape, needs_repair, and operator_input_required.

Validation rejects malformed Escape Candidate evidence, including blank work item, malformed source head, malformed review subject hash, missing evidence artifacts, unsupported status or signal values, invalid touched surface data, and invalid Boundary Prediction Record or Attribution Join Key references when supplied.

Validation rejects malformed Boundary Escape Disposition evidence, including missing candidate link, unsupported disposition verdict, missing Codex PM attribution rationale, missing evidence reviewed, missing operator-input status, or inconsistency between disposition verdict and required operator input.

Codex PM attribution review can record a confirmed escape only from repo-native evidence and must route genuinely ambiguous product, UAT, business, policy, explicit cost/risk, or scope judgments to operator_input_required instead of guessing.
Escape Candidate and Boundary Escape Disposition validation is included in aggregate bandit validate and template checks, with clear fail-closed diagnostics.
Existing ordinary safe-to-land bootstrap flows remain unblocked when no Escape Candidate or Boundary Escape Disposition evidence is claimed.

The implementation keeps escape artifact parsing, disposition validation, template seeding/checks, aggregate validation, and tests separated from future boundary-cell movement and Workflow Trial policy.

The work preserves role boundaries: Test Writer owns RED evidence and test edits; if Codex authors Stage 2 tests, Stage 3 implementation is routed to Claude or another non-Codex model family; reviewers own Stage 4; Landing Agent owns Stage 5; Closeout Agent owns Stage 6.

Stage 4 review uses Local Qwen only through .bandit/reviewers/local-qwen.json and node bin/omlx-chat-completions.mjs, CodeRabbit or honest provider-timeout/refusal evidence, aggregate review evidence, risk classification, and supply-chain evidence before landing.

The work item does not start PRD-004.4, PRD-005, the V0 Closeout Claude Code A/B Product-Value Trial, Trust Verifier cutover, cockpit UI, local API, State Index, hosted services, telemetry, public benchmark publication, paid routing, merge, push, deploy, or unrelated Phase 8 work.
test_plan: Stage 2 Test Writer writes RED tests for valid and malformed Escape Candidate evidence, including source head, review subject hash, evidence artifacts, status values, signal values, touched surface data, Boundary Prediction Record links, and Attribution Join Key links.

Stage 2 Test Writer writes RED tests for valid and malformed Boundary Escape Disposition evidence, including candidate link, disposition verdict, Codex PM rationale, evidence reviewed, operator-input status, and operator_input_required consistency.
Stage 2 Test Writer writes RED tests proving aggregate bandit validate includes escape-candidate and escape-disposition artifacts with fail-closed diagnostics.
Stage 2 Test Writer writes RED tests proving ordinary safe-to-land bootstrap flows remain unblocked when no escape evidence is claimed.
Run focused boundary escape or landing-gate tests after implementation.
Run npm test if shared validators, landing gates, artifact parsers, template checks, or validate command behavior changes.
Run node ./bin/bandit.mjs cockpit status --json and node ./bin/bandit.mjs session-context current --json after context artifacts are updated.
clean_code_read_evidence: CLEAN_CODE.md was read on 2026-06-10 before creating this source spec. The slice must keep Escape Candidate parsing, Boundary Escape Disposition validation, template checks, aggregate validation, and tests small and explicit; avoid hidden workflow authority; preserve role boundaries; and avoid mixing boundary-cell movement, Workflow Trial movement, model gateway, cockpit, or PRD-005 controller behavior into this escape workflow slice.
stage_rubric_checklist: Stage 0: Context Readiness | pass | BANDIT-090 landed and closed with landing action, retrospective, improvement disposition, synchronized roadmap/current-context/status updates in progress, and no open bootstrap gaps; operator direction keeps PRD-004/005 ahead of WIL-V0-TRIAL.

Stage 1: Work-Item Brief And Spec | pass | This spec defines goal, scope, out of scope, acceptance criteria, test plan, clean-code read evidence, no-gap disposition, expected files, required evidence, role boundaries, operator-input status, source-of-truth boundary, forbidden actions, implementation order, and smell triggers.

Stage 2: Test Design And RED Evidence | required next | Test Writer must produce RED tests for Escape Candidate validation, Boundary Escape Disposition validation, aggregate validate integration, and ordinary safe-to-land non-regression before implementation.

Stage 3: Implementation Clean-Code Rubric | required later | Implementation must be routed to a different model family if Codex authors RED tests and must not edit RED tests, test helpers, fixtures, acceptance mappings, or Test Writer-owned evidence.

Stage 4: Review And Cross-Model Gates | required later | Local Qwen through the authorized MLX route, CodeRabbit or honest provider-timeout/refusal evidence, aggregate review, review-subject hash, risk/supply-chain checks where applicable, and clean-code review are required before landing.

Stage 5: Landing And UAT | required later | Landing verdict, land-check, local-record landing action, and clean-code compliance evidence are required; product UAT is not applicable unless the implementation changes an operator-facing product surface.

Stage 6: Retrospective And Improvement Capture | required later | Retrospective, improvement/no-action dispositions, current context, roadmap, and STATUS updates are required before PRD-004.4, PRD-005, V0 trial, or unrelated next work begins.
bootstrap_gaps: No open bootstrap gap blocks this PRD-004.3 implementation slice.
Live CodeRabbit may time out or be unavailable; if so, record provider-timeout/bootstrap replacement evidence and do not claim a CodeRabbit pass.

Local Qwen is authorized only through .bandit/reviewers/local-qwen.json and bin/omlx-chat-completions.mjs against the MLX OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1. If the endpoint or adapter is unavailable, stop and ask the operator for help rather than substituting another reviewer route.

No boundary-cell movement, contour contraction, autonomy expansion, model gateway, live model-call capture, Trust Verifier cutover, Notify-And-Revert execution, public benchmark publication, merge, push, deploy, paid routing, hosted service, telemetry, local API, State Index, or cockpit UI authority is approved by this slice.
first_implementation_order: Repo PM creates the work item and records formation review evidence before Work Item PM execution.
Work Item PM records orchestration-plan.md only after formation_approved and before RED evidence.
Test Writer writes failing tests for Escape Candidate validation, Boundary Escape Disposition validation, aggregate validate integration, and ordinary safe-to-land non-regression.

Implementation Writer adds the minimal templates, parser/validator helpers, template checks, and aggregate validate integration needed to satisfy RED tests, without editing Test Writer-owned files if Codex authored the RED tests.
Codex PM verifies focused tests, typecheck, full tests as needed, Bandit validation, cockpit/session-context derived status, clean-code compliance, and evidence freshness before Stage 4 review.
Reviewers run Local Qwen through the authorized MLX route and CodeRabbit or honest provider-timeout/refusal evidence; PM dispositions any non-blocking findings before landing.
Landing Agent writes landing verdict/action; Closeout Agent records retrospective, improvement/no-action disposition, and synchronizes current context, roadmap, STATUS, and intake state.
smell_triggers: Any implementation that changes Boundary Contour movement policy, contracts autonomy, expands autonomy, executes rollback behavior, sends operator attention, or starts Workflow Trial movement is scope creep.
Any implementation that treats Escape Candidate evidence as a confirmed escape without a separate Codex PM Boundary Escape Disposition is a blocker.
Any implementation that guesses on product, UAT, business, policy, explicit cost/risk, or genuinely ambiguous scope judgments instead of recording operator_input_required is a blocker.
Any implementation that requires escape evidence for ordinary safe-to-land bootstrap flows that do not claim a boundary escape or escape disposition is a blocker.

Any implementation that accepts malformed source head, review subject hash, evidence artifact hash, candidate status, disposition verdict, Boundary Prediction Record reference, Attribution Join Key reference, or touched surface where required is a blocker.

Any implementation that starts PRD-004.4, PRD-005 command-controller work, model gateway, Trust Verifier cutover, cockpit UI, local API, State Index, hosted service, telemetry, paid routing, merge, push, deploy, public benchmark publication, or unrelated Phase 8 work is scope creep.
Any large mixed function that combines escape parsing, disposition validation, boundary-cell movement, Workflow Trial policy, operator inbox delivery, and landing execution is a clean-code blocker.
operator_input_status: No operator-owned input is required to create and form this PRD-004.3 escape candidate workflow slice because BANDIT-PRD-004 is accepted, BANDIT-089 and BANDIT-090 landed the prerequisite boundary evidence and attribution contracts, the operator directed PRD-004/005 implementation before WIL-V0-TRIAL, and the slice explicitly avoids boundary-cell movement, autonomy expansion, rollback execution, model gateway behavior, and PRD-005 controllers. Halt for operator input if later work would expand Notify-And-Revert or Auto-Landing Scope, move a boundary cell, change product or UAT direction, approve public benchmark claims, approve paid or live reviewer/model routing, approve hosted services, approve telemetry, approve merge/push/deploy authority, approve Trust Verifier cutover, approve external side effects, or resolve genuinely ambiguous product, business, policy, UAT, or explicit cost/risk scope.
